entities.name: Theory of Evolution
entities.label: Idea
entities.summary: The scientific theory that all species arise through natural selection acting on inherited variation. Formulated by Darwin in 1859, it unified biology, challenged religious orthodoxy, and remains the foundational framework of the life sciences.
